entities.summary: Anshuman Singh was an Indian judge and governor. He served as the Governor of Gujarat from 1998 to 1999 and as the Governor of Rajasthan from 1999 to 2003. Prior to his gubernatorial roles, he was a judge of the Allahabad High Court and later served in the Rajasthan High Court.
